description: React component 'ConditionalPublicModelName' manages model name mappings within a form, including dynamic updates based on user selection, provider, and custom model name changes. It renders a form item with a table for mapping public model names to internal LiteLLM model names, and includes various tooltips and conditional logic.

methods.name: ConditionalPublicModelName
methods.description: React functional component managing model name mappings with effects to sync form state based on user input and selections.
